about: s255-m04 (settled 14): the sources the importer's Remembered proposal is proven on. Fixtures are minimal excerpts written from each published schema, or written for this proof; none is a copy of a product's file.

mem0.name: openapi.json
mem0.cite: A minimal excerpt written from Mem0's published API description, https://docs.mem0.ai/openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.0.1, "Mem0 API Docs" v1, read 2026-11-27): ten of the fifteen properties of the 200 response of GET /v1/memories/{memory_id}/, with their published types, formats, nullability and descriptions, word for word.

postgres.name: memory.sql
postgres.cite: A team's own Postgres memory store, written for this proof from R3 §5.2's description of its run D (cmos/research/memory-2026-11-26/R3-foundry-today.md); it is not any product's schema. A chat table (messages) is the control.

microsoft.name: openapi.json
microsoft.cite: A minimal excerpt written from Microsoft's published MemoryItem, as R2 read it from the Azure REST API specs at commit c0a72f399e71 (specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry, openapi3/v1/microsoft-foundry-openapi3.json; https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs): its five properties, two descriptions word for word.
